summary: On the main deck, Tank watches something on a screen — evidently the fate of Morpheus, whom the others have just been forced to leave behind. He reaches out toward the screen "as if reaching for Morpheus" and cries out "No!" in grief and helplessness.

what_changes.before: Watching the screen, presumably as events unfold for Morpheus
what_changes.after: Overcome with grief, reaching toward the screen and crying out in denial
what_changes.evidence: Tank reaches out to the screen as if reaching for Morpheus.

event_hint.one_line: Tank reacts with anguish as Morpheus is captured/left behind.

uncertain: Whether Tank is watching Morpheus's capture in real time or receiving news of it.
Whether anyone else is present on the main deck.
